# PlowWow

> PlowWow is Greater Vancouver's 24/7 snow removal and de-icing company serving residential homeowners, strata corporations, and commercial properties across BC's Lower Mainland. PlowWow also builds and operates snow removal contractor software (dispatch app, GPS fleet tracking, Salt-Scan AI).

## Company
- Founded: Surrey, BC, Canada
- Phone: 604-761-1518
- Address: 19906 32 Ave, Langley, BC V3A 4T1
- Owner: Industry Army Marketing Inc.

## Core Services
- Residential snow removal (driveways, walkways)
- Strata snow removal (full-property management)
- Commercial snow removal (parking lots, loading docks)
- De-icing and salting (liquid and granular)
- 24/7 emergency snow response

## Technology Platform
- PWIE Engine (Predictive Winter Intelligence Engine)
- Weather Brain (hyperlocal forecast integration)
- Salt-Scan AI (usage optimization)
- Ghost Fleet GPS (real-time truck tracking)
- Wow-Shield™ (liability documentation vault)

## Service Areas (Greater Vancouver, BC)
Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Langley, Delta, New Westminster, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Maple Ridge, Mission, White Rock, Pitt Meadows, Squamish, Tsawwassen, Steveston, Fort Langley, Cloverdale, Lynn Valley, Kitsilano, Marpole, Oakridge, Fraserview, Metrotown
